title: 1987 AMC 8 Problem 12
statement: What fraction of the large \(12\) by \(18\) rectangular region is shaded?

solutions.text:
The whole region has area \(12 \times 18 = 216.\) The shaded region is \(3\) wide and \(6\) tall, with area \(3 \times 6 = 18.\)

So the shaded fraction is \(\dfrac{18}{216} = \dfrac{1}{12}.\) Equivalently, it is \(\dfrac13\) of \(\dfrac14\) of the whole.

Thus, the correct answer is C .
hints: The horizontal line splits the rectangle into a top half and a bottom half
The shaded part is the rightmost third of the bottom-right quarter of the rectangle
